ptr.note: Call-scoped borrow; no caller pointer retained. Context storage and children remain C-owned; byte buffers have the scalar length/count or backend digest size.

Output of exactly the algorithm's hash length (16..64 bytes) after C checks outlen >= hashlen (else AVERROR(EINVAL), nothing written or changed). outlen is an upper bound and may be any unsigned int up to the buffer length (UINT_MAX for longer buffers); C also reads the written digest back through out. No retention.
